title: ChatHealthy DevOps Utterance
description: One utterance in the conversation archive: what was said, by whom, when, and how it is classified. The archive is business data, not a log. Time is carried twice on purpose -- `timestamp` is a native date for indexing and ordering, `timestamp_pacific` is a Pacific 12-hour rendering for reading. Governs ClaudeCodeUtterances.utterances and realizes EPIC-008-F-013: capture (S-001), purge (S-002), categorize (S-003). Classification enumerations are seeded from the operator's examples on 2026-08-08 and are expected to change; a classifier MUST reject any value absent from them.

_id.description: MongoDB document identifier. Assigned by the database, never by the writer.

timestamp.description: When the utterance was MADE, as a native database date (BSON date, a UTC instant). This is the indexed, sortable field: comparing instants means ordering is correct through daylight-saving transitions. For captured utterances it comes from the spool filename, stamped the instant the hook fired; for ported records, from the ObjectId creation time. Not a string -- it has no JSON Schema type.

role.description: The speaker's PART in the exchange, not their identity. 'service' and 'agent' appear only on records written by an earlier archival job.

content.description: What was said, verbatim. MUST NOT be summarised, paraphrased, answered or replaced. The only permitted alteration is the removal of a credential, secret or expletive, which leaves a marker in its place.

tone.description: How it was said -- manner of delivery, never the act underneath. Assigned at ingest by the Gemini classifier. Absent means the classifier was unavailable when the record was archived; that is the signal a later pass uses to find unclassified records. Values are those observed across 38,876 archived utterances, hand-audited at 98/100 agreement.

utterance_class.description: What it was doing -- the act, never the manner. Independent of tone: a reprimand delivered calmly is still a reprimand. Assigned at ingest by the Gemini classifier. Values are those observed across 38,876 archived utterances, hand-audited at 90/100 agreement.

classified_at.description: When classification was performed. Pacific, 24-hour. Its absence is how the daily pass finds work, so it MUST be written only after both tone and utterance_class are set.

classifier_version.description: Which revision of this schema the classification was made against. The enumerations change; without this a value assigned under an older revision cannot be told from a current one.

utterance.description: Legacy field on 1,331 records written by an earlier archival job. Not produced by the current pipeline.

_archived_at.description: Legacy field from an earlier archival job. Not produced by the current pipeline.

_archived_by_job.description: Legacy field from an earlier archival job. Written as both string and integer. Not produced by the current pipeline.

action.description: Legacy field on 29 records from an earlier archival job.

outcome.description: Legacy field on 29 records from an earlier archival job.

counts.description: Legacy field on a handful of records from an earlier archival job.

jobId.description: Legacy field on a handful of records from an earlier archival job. Written as both string and integer.

preservePastTime.description: Legacy field on a handful of records from an earlier archival job.

timestamp_pacific.description: The same instant rendered for reading: Pacific time, 12-hour, YYYY-MM-DD H:MM:SS AM/PM. Display only. It MUST NOT be sorted or indexed on -- a 12-hour clock does not order lexically.

archived_at.description: When the record reached the archive, as a native database date. The difference between this and `timestamp` is archiving latency.

user.description: WHO the human is. An identifier for the person who spoke, not their part in the exchange. Present only on utterances made by a human; absent on Claude's and on service utterances. One operator today, more later.
